## Intro

Fit climate-agnostic sdms for calculating biomass trends and velocities

## Load packages & source functions

```{r load libraries}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(tidylog)
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(RCurl)
library(devtools)
library(patchwork)
library(kableExtra)
library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(sdmTMB)

# Source code for map plots
devtools::source_url("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maxlindmark/spatial-metabolic-index/main/R/functions/map-plot.R")
options(ggplot2.continuous.colour = "viridis")

# Set path
home <- here::here()
```

## Read data

```{r read data}
# Read data
d <- read_csv(paste0(home, "/data/clean/catch_clean.csv")) |>
  add_utm_columns(ll_names = c("lon", "lat")) |> 
  mutate(life_stage = ifelse(str_ends(group, "juvenile"), "juvenile", "all"),
         life_stage = ifelse(str_ends(group, "adult"), "adult", life_stage)) |> 
  filter(!group %in% c("whiting_all", "turbot_all")) |> 
  filter(year >= 1991)
```

## Scale variables

```{r}
pred_grid <- bind_rows(readr::read_csv(paste0(home, "/data/clean/pred_grid_(1_2).csv")),
                       readr::read_csv(paste0(home, "/data/clean/pred_grid_(2_2).csv")))

d <- d |> 
  mutate(temp_sc = (temp - mean(pred_grid$temp)) / sd(pred_grid$temp),
         temp_sq = temp_sc^2,
         oxy_sc = (oxy - mean(pred_grid$oxy)) / sd(pred_grid$oxy),
         oxy_sq = oxy_sc^2,
         sal_sc = (sal - mean(pred_grid$sal)) / sd(pred_grid$sal),
         depth_sc = (depth - mean(pred_grid$depth)) / sd(pred_grid$depth),
         depth_sq = depth_sc*depth_sc,
         month_f = as.factor(month),
         year_ct = (year - mean(year)) / 10)

# Scale the grid and filter
pred_grid <- pred_grid |>
  mutate(temp_sc = (temp - mean(temp)) / sd(temp),
         temp_sq = temp_sc^2,
         oxy_sc = (oxy - mean(oxy)) / sd(oxy),
         oxy_sq = oxy_sc^2,
         sal_sc = (sal - mean(sal)) / sd(sal),
         depth_sc = (depth - mean(depth)) / sd(depth),
         depth_sq = depth_sc*depth_sc,
         month_f = as.factor(month),
         year_ct = (year - mean(d$year)) / 10) |> 
  filter(quarter == 4) |> 
  filter(year >= 1991)
```

## Fit models
Use only quarter 4 since that's what we are looking for (warmer and less oxygen than q1), and note also we use a spatial trend model

```{r fit random model to get spatial trend}
# https://pbs-assess.github.io/sdmTMB/articles/spatial-trend-models.html

pred_grid_list <- list()
res_list <- list()
year_intercepts_list <- list()

for(i in unique(d$group)) { 
    
  dd <- d |>
    filter(group == i & quarter == 4)
  
  mesh <- make_mesh(dd, xy_cols = c("X", "Y"), cutoff = 12)
  
  plot(mesh)
  
  # This is a variant of the main model without environmental fixed effects
  m <- sdmTMB(density ~ year_ct + depth_sc + depth_sq,
              data = dd,
              mesh = mesh,
              family = delta_gamma(type = "poisson-link"),
              spatiotemporal = "iid",
              spatial = "on",
              spatial_varying = ~0 + year_ct,
              time = "year")  
  
  # Check the model converges
  sanity(m)
  tidy(m, "ran_pars", conf.int = TRUE, model = 1)
  tidy(m, "ran_pars", conf.int = TRUE, model = 2)

  # Plot combined residuals
  res <- simulate(m, nsim = 300, type = "mle-mvn") |>
      dharma_residuals(m, plot = FALSE) |>
      mutate(group = i)
  
  # Store residuals
  res_list[[i]] <- res
  
  sort(unique(d$year))
  sort(unique(pred_grid$year))
  
  # Predict on grid 
  p <- predict(m, newdata = pred_grid |> filter(year %in% c(dd$year))) |>
    mutate(group = i)
  
  # Save
  pred_grid_list[[i]] <- p
  
  # Extract the main overall (fixed effect) coefficient of centered year to construct actual time slopes
  coefs1 <- tidy(m, conf.int = TRUE, model = 1)
  coefs2 <- tidy(m, conf.int = TRUE, model = 2)
  
  scaled_year_coef1 <- coefs1$estimate[coefs1$term == "year_ct"]
  scaled_year_coef2 <- coefs2$estimate[coefs2$term == "year_ct"]
  
  # Our main effect tells us that the overall linear trend of density has been a multiplicative factor of scaled_year_coef per decade.
  # Conversely, the overall trend has been a decline of 1-scaled_year_coef % per decade.
  1 - exp(scaled_year_coef1)
  1 - exp(scaled_year_coef2)
  
  # Store the coefficients (in log space)
  year_intercepts_list[[i]] <- tibble(year_ct_m1 = scaled_year_coef1,
                                      year_ct_m2 = scaled_year_coef2,
                                      group = i)
}

# Save predictions and sims as data frames
preds_grid <- dplyr::bind_rows(pred_grid_list) |> as.data.frame()
year_inter <- dplyr::bind_rows(year_intercepts_list) |> as.data.frame()
res <- dplyr::bind_rows(res_list) |> as.data.frame()
```

## Save

```{r}
write_csv(res, paste0(home, "/output/residuals_04_sdms.csv"))
write_csv(year_inter, paste0(home, "/output/year_intercept_04_sdms.csv"))
write_csv(preds_grid, paste0(home, "/output/pred_grids_04_random_sdms.csv"))
```

## Plot residuals

```{r}
# Plot residuals
res |> 
  separate(group, into = c("common_name", "life_stage"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE) |> 
  mutate(group2 = paste(str_to_sentence(life_stage), common_name)) |>
  ggplot(aes(observed, expected)) +
  geom_point(color = "grey30", shape = 21, size = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(col = "tomato3", linewidth = 0.6) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~group2) +
  labs(x = "Observed", y = "Expected")

ggsave(paste0(home, "/figures/supp/qq_sdm_04.pdf"), width = 17, height = 14, units = "cm")
```
